entities.name: Lysosomal acid glucosylceramidase
observations: Query sequence (343 aa; contains one ambiguous X) aligns to reviewed human GBA1 UniProt P04062 at 35.3% identity, 86.9% query coverage, E=1.55e-80; functional assignment is homology-supported, not direct experimental characterization of query.

Curated human reference hydrolyzes glucosylceramide to ceramide and D-glucose in lysosomes; also reported to hydrolyze galactosylceramide and cholesteryl glucoside and transfer glucose to cholesterol.

entities.name: Glucosylceramide hydrolysis
observations: Rhea:13269; beta-D-glucosyl-(1↔1')-N-acylsphing-4-enine + H2O → N-acylsphing-4-enine (ceramide) + D-glucose. Candidate activity inferred for the query from homolog annotations.
